analysis.crux: The whole dispute reduces to one question: whether the $8,000 their parent gave Jordan counts as an advance on inheritance. That is the single fact the kernel cannot — and will not — decide for you. Everything else above follows from your answer to it.
dissolved: The $10000.00-vs-$14000.00 gap is a number to correct, not a deception: the items simply add up to $14000.00.

genuine_conflicts.description: Whether the $8,000 their parent gave Jordan counts as an advance on inheritance — a real disagreement of fact and judgment, not just different words.

ledger_findings: If the $8,000 their parent gave Jordan counts as an advance on inheritance: the certified amount is $26000.00. If not: $34000.00.
The stated figure of $10000.00 is not what the itemization supports — the items total $14000.00.
